title: 林塔爾抽蓄水電工程
summary: 林塔爾 2015 工程在瑞士格拉魯斯阿爾卑斯山區，把穆特湖與利默恩湖之間約 630 m 的落差開發成 1,000 MW 的變速抽蓄電站；課程定量分析高海拔長重力壩的施工、傾斜壓力鋼管井的內壓，以及壩面太陽能在冬季的發電特性。
summaryEn: Linthal 2015 in the Glarus Alps of Switzerland developed about 630 m of fall between Lake Mutt and Lake Limmern into a 1,000 MW variable-speed pumped-storage plant; the course quantifies building a long gravity dam at high altitude, internal pressure in the inclined steel-lined shafts, and the winter generating behaviour of solar panels on the dam face.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 海拔 2,500 m 的重力壩、六百公尺級水頭與變速機組
v30FocusEn: A gravity dam at 2,500 m altitude, a 600 m-class head and variable-speed units

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：林塔爾抽蓄水電工程
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Linthal Pumped Storage Project
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「上池蓄能量」與「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Winter generation from solar panels on the dam": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「上池蓄能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" is correct?
options: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。
抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。
太陽能在冬天幾乎發不了電，尤其是在寒冷的高山上。
optionsEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head.
Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more.
Solar hardly generates in winter, least of all on cold mountains.
quiz.explanation: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「上池蓄能量」如何決定「林塔爾抽蓄水電工程」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Linthal Pumped Storage Project”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。與電池不同，功率（由機組與水道決定）和能量（由水庫容積決定）可以分開設計，因此同樣的機組可以搭配數小時到數十小時的蓄能。上池水位變動時水頭跟著改變，機組必須在整個水頭變幅內都能穩定發電與抽水。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head. Unlike a battery, power, set by the units and waterways, and energy, set by reservoir volume, can be designed separately, so the same units can be paired with a few hours to tens of hours of storage. As the upper level changes so does the head, and the units must generate and pump stably across the whole head range. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：4 台變速可逆式機組各 250 MW，總容量 1,000 MW
steps.observationEn: Project file: Four variable-speed reversible units of 250 MW give 1,000 MW
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「上池蓄能量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Energy stored in the upper reservoir”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir
knowledge.text: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。與電池不同，功率（由機組與水道決定）和能量（由水庫容積決定）可以分開設計，因此同樣的機組可以搭配數小時到數十小時的蓄能。上池水位變動時水頭跟著改變，機組必須在整個水頭變幅內都能穩定發電與抽水。
knowledge.textEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head. Unlike a battery, power, set by the units and waterways, and energy, set by reservoir volume, can be designed separately, so the same units can be paired with a few hours to tens of hours of storage. As the upper level changes so does the head, and the units must generate and pump stably across the whole head range.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 4 台變速可逆式機組各 250 MW，總容量 1,000 MW
knowledge.textEn: Four variable-speed reversible units of 250 MW give 1,000 MW

quiz.question: 依「上池蓄能量」的模型 E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²，上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹² for "Energy stored in the upper reservoir", which value is closest to the energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)?
options: 19.3 GWh
38.6 GWh
386 GWh
optionsEn: 19.3 GWh
38.6 GWh
386 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Vu = 25 hm³、H = 630 m、η = 0.9，得 38.6 GWh（上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Vu = 25 hm³, H = 630 m, η = 0.9 the result is 38.6 GWh (energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上池蓄能量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Vu = 25 hm³、H = 630 m、η = 0.9，得 38.6 GWh（上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Vu 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Vu = 25 hm³, H = 630 m, η = 0.9 the result is 38.6 GWh (energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Vu by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Vu 增加 10% 時，結果變為 42.5 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Vu by 10% changes the result to 42.5 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 38.6 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Vu 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 38.6 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Vu with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Vu = 25 hm³、H = 630 m、η = 0.9，得 38.6 GWh（上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量）。
knowledge.textEn: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Vu = 25 hm³, H = 630 m, η = 0.9 the result is 38.6 GWh (energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Vu 增加 10% 時，結果變為 42.5 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Vu by 10% changes the result to 42.5 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「上池蓄能量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy stored in the upper reservoir"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
水頭越高只是壓力大一點，對壓力管道的設計沒有本質影響。
以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher head just means a little more pressure and does not change penstock design fundamentally.

Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters.
quiz.explanation: 以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上池蓄能量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要分別寫明額定功率、可用蓄能量與對應的水位範圍，並註明效率與水頭的計算基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specifications should state rated power, usable energy and the corresponding level range separately, with the efficiency and head basis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書要分別寫明額定功率、可用蓄能量與對應的水位範圍，並註明效率與水頭的計算基準。
knowledge.textEn: Specifications should state rated power, usable energy and the corresponding level range separately, with the efficiency and head basis.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60193 水輪機、蓄能泵與水泵水輪機模型驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60193 Hydraulic turbines, storage pumps and pump-turbines – Model acceptance tests. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「上池蓄能量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
太陽能在冬天幾乎發不了電，尤其是在寒冷的高山上。
optionsEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Solar hardly generates in winter, least of all on cold mountains.
quiz.explanation: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上池蓄能量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「林塔爾抽蓄水電工程」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Linthal Pumped Storage Project”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：上池水位變動時水頭跟著改變，機組必須在整個水頭變幅內都能穩定發電與抽水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: As the upper level changes so does the head, and the units must generate and pump stably across the whole head range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。
knowledge.textEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Winter generation from solar panels on the dam" is correct?
options: 太陽能在冬天幾乎發不了電，尤其是在寒冷的高山上。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
穆特湖壩朝南，壩面上安裝了約五千片雙面模組。
optionsEn: Solar hardly generates in winter, least of all on cold mountains.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
The Muttsee dam faces south and carries about five thousand bifacial modules.
quiz.explanation: 穆特湖壩朝南，壩面上安裝了約五千片雙面模組。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Muttsee dam faces south and carries about five thousand bifacial modules. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壩面太陽能的冬季發電：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Winter generation from solar panels on the dam: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」如何決定「林塔爾抽蓄水電工程」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Winter generation from solar panels on the dam” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Linthal Pumped Storage Project”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 穆特湖壩朝南，壩面上安裝了約五千片雙面模組。高山上空氣稀薄乾淨、冬季常在雲霧之上，加上雪地反射與低溫使電池效率提高，這座電站約有一半的電量產生在十月到三月之間，而平地的太陽能電站冬季只占四分之一左右。對冬季缺電的瑞士而言，這種季節特性比總發電量更有價值；模組以陡角安裝也使積雪容易滑落。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Muttsee dam faces south and carries about five thousand bifacial modules. Thin clean air at altitude, frequent winter days above the cloud, reflection from snow and low temperature that raises cell efficiency mean about half the plant's energy comes between October and March, against roughly a quarter for lowland solar. For Switzerland, short of power in winter, this seasonal profile is worth more than total yield, and steep mounting lets snow slide off. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：上池穆特湖位於海拔約 2,474 m，重力壩長約 1,054 m，為瑞士最長的壩
steps.observationEn: Project file: The upper reservoir, Lake Mutt, lies at about 2,474 m and its gravity dam, about 1,054 m long, is the longest in Switzerland
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「太陽能在冬天幾乎發不了電，尤其是在寒冷的高山上。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Solar hardly generates in winter, least of all on cold mountains." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Winter generation from solar panels on the dam”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 依「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」的模型 E_w = P·Y·f_w，裝置 2.2 MWp、年比發電量 1,500 kWh/kWp、冬季占比 50% 時的冬季發電量（代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E_w = P·Y·f_w for "Winter generation from solar panels on the dam", which value is closest to the winter energy for 2.2 MWp at 1,500 kWh/kWp a year with a 50% winter share (representative)?
options: 825 MWh
optionsEn: 825 MWh
quiz.explanation: E_w = P·Y·f_w；代入 P = 2.2 MWp、Y = 1500 kWh/kWp、fw = 0.5，得 1,650 MWh（裝置 2.2 MWp、年比發電量 1,500 kWh/kWp、冬季占比 50% 時的冬季發電量（代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E_w = P·Y·f_w; with P = 2.2 MWp, Y = 1500 kWh/kWp, fw = 0.5 the result is 1,650 MWh (winter energy for 2.2 MWp at 1,500 kWh/kWp a year with a 50% winter share (representative)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 壩面太陽能的冬季發電：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Winter generation from solar panels on the dam: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Winter generation from solar panels on the dam” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E_w = P·Y·f_w；代入 P = 2.2 MWp、Y = 1500 kWh/kWp、fw = 0.5，得 1,650 MWh（裝置 2.2 MWp、年比發電量 1,500 kWh/kWp、冬季占比 50% 時的冬季發電量（代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 fw 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E_w = P·Y·f_w; with P = 2.2 MWp, Y = 1500 kWh/kWp, fw = 0.5 the result is 1,650 MWh (winter energy for 2.2 MWp at 1,500 kWh/kWp a year with a 50% winter share (representative)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise fw by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：fw 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,815 MWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising fw by 10% changes the result to 1,815 MWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1,650 MWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 fw 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1,650 MWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in fw with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E_w = P·Y·f_w；代入 P = 2.2 MWp、Y = 1500 kWh/kWp、fw = 0.5，得 1,650 MWh（裝置 2.2 MWp、年比發電量 1,500 kWh/kWp、冬季占比 50% 時的冬季發電量（代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E_w = P·Y·f_w; with P = 2.2 MWp, Y = 1500 kWh/kWp, fw = 0.5 the result is 1,650 MWh (winter energy for 2.2 MWp at 1,500 kWh/kWp a year with a 50% winter share (representative)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: fw 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,815 MWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising fw by 10% changes the result to 1,815 MWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Winter generation from solar panels on the dam"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以模組面日射計（含背面）與電表逐月計算比發電量與性能比，並和同一業主的平地電站比較冬夏比例。
岩石很堅硬，地下洞室挖好後不需要支撐也不會變形。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Compute monthly specific yield and performance ratio from plane-of-array pyranometers, including rear side, and meters, and compare the winter-summer split with the owner's lowland plants.
Rock is hard, so an underground cavern needs no support and does not deform once excavated.
quiz.explanation: 以模組面日射計（含背面）與電表逐月計算比發電量與性能比，並和同一業主的平地電站比較冬夏比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute monthly specific yield and performance ratio from plane-of-array pyranometers, including rear side, and meters, and compare the winter-summer split with the owner's lowland plants. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壩面太陽能的冬季發電：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Winter generation from solar panels on the dam: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Winter generation from solar panels on the dam” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以模組面日射計（含背面）與電表逐月計算比發電量與性能比，並和同一業主的平地電站比較冬夏比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute monthly specific yield and performance ratio from plane-of-array pyranometers, including rear side, and meters, and compare the winter-summer split with the owner's lowland plants. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：高山太陽能的結構設計要以實測雪載與風載為準，並以冬季發電占比作為主要績效指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural design of alpine solar should follow measured snow and wind loads, with winter share of generation the main performance indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：強風與積雪滑落的衝擊使邊框與夾具受損；模組下緣若被雪堆遮住，整串電流受限。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Strong wind and the impact of sliding snow damage frames and clamps, and snow piled over the lower edge limits current of the whole string. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以模組面日射計（含背面）與電表逐月計算比發電量與性能比，並和同一業主的平地電站比較冬夏比例。
knowledge.textEn: Compute monthly specific yield and performance ratio from plane-of-array pyranometers, including rear side, and meters, and compare the winter-summer split with the owner's lowland plants.

quiz.question: 在「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Winter generation from solar panels on the dam" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
強風與積雪滑落的衝擊使邊框與夾具受損；模組下緣若被雪堆遮住，整串電流受限。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
Strong wind and the impact of sliding snow damage frames and clamps, and snow piled over the lower edge limits current of the whole string.

quiz.explanationEn: Strong wind and the impact of sliding snow damage frames and clamps, and snow piled over the lower edge limits current of the whole string. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
